name: Ambenonium

similar.name: Diclofenac
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems and heart harm

summary: Ambenonium was given a low liver score of 47 and a low heart score of 30 by a small computer model rather than through tests on people [M]. The drug itself has no listed problems in these records, but it is 33 percent similar to another drug called Diclofenac [3]. In the United States, Diclofenac carries a boxed warning for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems, and heart harm [3].
